records.text: Banished for treason, Tirion Fordring wants to help his son Taelan recover what he has lost through reminders of their shared past and the Order of the Silver Hand. He rejects judging honor by race, recalling honorable orcs and vile humans.
Suffering Victim is a humanoid.
Blighted Surge is an elemental in the Eastern Plaguelands that attacks with Toxic Bolt. When struck by Aspect of Neptulon, it can change into a Discordant Surge.
Plague Ravager is an elemental that changes into Discordant Surge when struck by Aspect of Neptulon.
Blighted Horror is an elemental that uses Fear and Drowning Death in combat, and changes into Discordant Surge when struck by Aspect of Neptulon.
Plague Monstrosity is an elemental that uses Mighty Blow in combat and changes into Discordant Surge when struck by Aspect of Neptulon.
Scourge Soldier is a humanoid fighter who uses Strike in combat.
Cursed Mage is a humanoid mage who casts Arcane Bolt in combat.
Scourge Warder is a humanoid combatant who uses Shield Block.
Dark Caster is a spellcasting combatant whose attack is Shadow Bolt.
Scourge Guard is a guard-named combatant whose attack is Shield Slam.
Dread Weaver fights with Fear and Mind Flay.
Scourge Champion meets opponents with Mortal Strike.
Cannibal Ghoul casts Summon Darrowshire Spirit when it dies.
Gibbering Ghoul uses Curse of Tongues in combat and summons a Darrowshire Spirit when it dies; the summoned spirit is distinct from the ghoul.
An undead flayer that can cast Birth and Summon Darrowshire Spirit, the latter on death.
An undead gargoyle that attacks with Putrid Bile.
An undead shrieker that attacks with Sonic Burst.
An undead creature whose combat call for help is a high-pitched screech.
An undead watcher whose combat call for help is a high-pitched screech.
An undead screamer that attacks with Banshee Curse.
Hate Shrieker is an undead that uses Banshee Curse and Deafening Screech in combat.
Death Singer is an undead that uses Banshee Curse and Terrifying Screech in combat.
Stitched Horror is an undead that uses Mighty Blow in combat.
Gangled Golem is an undead that uses Knockdown in combat.
Stitched Golem is an undead that casts Disease Cloud.
A Dark Adept of the Cult of the Damned is a humanoid who uses Snap Kick in combat.
A Death Cultist of the Cult of the Damned, this humanoid cult member uses Shadow Shock in combat.
Known as a Vile Tutor, this humanoid bears the Cult of the Damned affiliation and uses Shadow Shield in combat.
A Shadowmage of the Cult of the Damned, this humanoid maintains Shadowform outside combat and casts Shadow Bolt in combat. When badly wounded, it may flee for assistance.
A Dark Summoner of the Cult of the Damned, this humanoid uses Arcane Bolt in combat.
A Necromancer of the Cult of the Damned, this humanoid maintains Shadowform outside combat.
This Crypt Stalker is a beast. In combat it uses Crypt Scarabs.
An undead crypt creature encountered in the Eastern Plaguelands region. In combat, it can cast Web.
An undead crypt creature encountered in the Eastern Plaguelands region. In combat, it can summon a carrion scarab.
An undead crypt creature encountered in the Eastern Plaguelands region. When badly wounded, it can use Fatal Sting.
A Mossflayer scout found in the Eastern Plaguelands region. In combat, it can use Hamstring.
A Mossflayer shadowhunter found in the Eastern Plaguelands region. It can shoot at foes and, when badly wounded, flee for assistance.
A Mossflayer cannibal found in the Eastern Plaguelands region. In combat, it can use Hex.
A Woodsman named among the targets of The Ranger Lord’s Behest. In combat, this humanoid uses Sunder Armor.
A Ranger named among the targets of The Ranger Lord’s Behest. In combat, this humanoid uses Shoot.
A Pathstrider named among the targets of The Ranger Lord’s Behest. In combat, this humanoid uses Faerie Fire.
A Plaguehound Runt, one of the nuisances described in Demon Dogs. It appears across several Eastern Plaguelands areas and uses a combat spell.
A Plaguehound, one of the nuisances described in Demon Dogs. It can use Infected Wound in combat.
A Frenzied Plaguehound that enters a frenzy when badly hurt: its low-health response casts Enrage and displays a frenzy emote.
Plaguebats are aggressive, plague-tainted wildlife in the Plaguelands. They attack with a terrifying screech and are hunted as a threat to travelers.
Noxious Plaguebats are troublesome winged beasts around the Plaguelands. They attack with a slowing poison and are hunted alongside other bats near Nathanos Blightcaller's farm.
Monstrous Plaguebats are large, dangerous winged beasts of the Plaguelands. Their sonic burst marks them as a distinct threat among the bats hunted in the region.
Carrion Grubs are carrion-feeding creatures found among the Plaguelands' corrupted wildlife. They attack with maggot slime.
Living Decay is an unusual Plaguelands elemental. It casts a spell as its health falls, suggesting an active combat role.
Rotting Sludge uses Black Sludge in combat.

A Scarlet Crusade rank who treats the Scourge's taint as a mark of wickedness. The Warder voices the Crusade's promise to destroy the tainted and smite evil, addressing its threats to those it condemns.

Scarlet Praetorians speak for the Scarlet Crusade, accusing enemies of carrying the Scourge’s taint. They invoke the Light as authority for killing those they condemn and vow to drive evil from their lands.

A Scarlet Crusade rank who treats the Scourge's taint as a mark of wickedness. The Cleric voices the Crusade's promise to destroy the tainted and smite evil, addressing its threats to those it condemns.

Scarlet Curates speak for the Scarlet Crusade, accusing enemies of carrying the Scourge’s taint and invoking the Light to condemn them. In combat they use Holy Smite and cast Dispel Magic when an ally is affected by crowd control.

A Scarlet Crusade archmage who denounces the Scourge and vows that the Crusade will destroy those it sees as tainted. His threats reflect the order’s uncompromising campaign against perceived evil; he also uses frost magic.

A Scarlet Crusade enchanter who condemns those it judges evil and vows to destroy the Scourge’s tainted. Its hostile rhetoric invokes both the Crusade and the Light, while its combat magic includes arcane bolts and sleep.

Aurora Skycaller is a high elf troubled by her people’s painful past. Though reluctant to dwell on her ancestors’ mistakes, she agrees to help restore the Crystal of Zin-Malor, an artifact shattered through evil use. She studies writings to learn how to repair it and insists the restored relic be entrusted only to someone trustworthy. Helping with this task eases her sorrow, though she says the past cannot simply be made right.
A summoned zombie is an undead creature called forth to serve its summoner. This entry is identified by that summoned form.

Duggan Wildhammer tells of going to the Plaguelands to drive the Scourge back underground. Cursed mead infected him with the plague, but he says his hopes have not sunk. Even through the haze, he recognizes an ogre by its smell and attacks it, still defiant despite his infection.
Hed'mush the Rotting is a named elite undead combatant, distinguished by his rotting epithet. He uses Mighty Blow in battle.
Warlord Thresh'jin is a named elite humanoid fighter. In combat he uses Whirlwind and Hamstring, bringing powerful area attacks and close-range control to a fight.
Zul'Brin Warpbranch is a named elite humanoid who fights with hexes, lightning and flame. He can also cast Healing Wave on an injured ally, supporting a companion during combat.
Ranger Lord Hawkspear is a named elite humanoid whose title marks him as a ranger lord. In close combat he uses Strike and Kick.
Gish the Unmoving is a named undead combatant that uses Gargoyle Strike and Rend.
Lord Darkscythe is a named undead combatant that uses Cleave and Sunder Armor.
Deathspeaker Selendre bears the Cult of the Damned affiliation. In combat, Selendre uses Shadow Bolt and Curse of Tongues.

Pamela Redpath is a lonely undead girl waiting for her family in their house. She misses her father and sister Jessica, asks visitors to find her doll and contact her aunt and uncle, and longs to share stories and play with her family again. Her lines move from anxiety about bad people near the house to delight at her doll and hope that her father is coming home.
The Ghost of the Past is a hostile spirit in the Andorhal area. It warns intruders to leave, then attacks and uses Frost Shock in combat.

Smokey LaRue is a paid demolition contractor whose work includes jobs for the Argent Dawn against the Scourge. He arranges the destruction of marked Plaguewood buildings with his own unstable explosive compound, while hiring others to gather its components and carry out the demolitions. He also has a fondness for tobacco, especially Fras Siabi’s premium stock, and describes himself as a capitalist.

Lord Maxwell Tyrosus is a senior Argent Dawn figure who personally honors allies for their service. He treats the recovered husk of the Colossus of Zora as strategically important, believing its secrets could aid the war against the Scourge, and expects the sample’s prompt delivery. His words to an honored ally are warm and formal, praising steadfast dedication.

Betina Bigglezink is an Argent Dawn researcher who has studied the plague for years and investigates its growing strength through fresh samples and Scourge data. She devised Dawn's Gambit to disrupt Scholomance scholars studying dragons, while admitting she is unsure it will work. Her reaction to its uncertain results is wry and practical: she welcomes the field evidence and expects months of analysis.

Leonid Barthalomew is an undead dissenter of the Scourge who serves the Argent Dawn. He regards his undeath as an illness to be treated, yet also as a means to strike the Scourge; the sacrifices behind his reputation matter more to him than its honors. He remembers Ras Frostwhisper's transformation into a lich and can identify the ground where it happened.

Caretaker Alen is an Argent Dawn caretaker at Light's Hope Chapel. He deals with the corpses placed in the cemetery pit and is fed up with Zaeldarr's gang stealing bodies; he calls for the troll leader to be stopped. He also wants Stratholme's restless souls aided and points to his associate Egan's work with ghosts.

Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff is an Argent Dawn authority who regards the Scarlet Crusade’s zealotry as destructive and directs the player against its leaders and archives. He praises capable obedience and frames the fight as divine justice, calling the player his champion when ordering Baron Rivendare’s defeat. He also recognizes efforts against the Scourge as service to the Dawn.

Carlin Redpath’s heart remains with Darrowshire, his home before the war destroyed it. The Annals move him deeply, especially their account of his brother Joseph and the battle’s heroes and villains. He pursues the village’s relics and the truth of their history, believing their fates are bound together and that they may help restore what was lost.
An Argent Dawn rider encountered in the Eastern Plaguelands, bearing the order's name as a title.

Egan is an inventor working to free the tortured souls haunting Stratholme. His blaster is meant to release them from their ghostly shells, and his compassion sets his mission apart from those who would destroy the innocent undead. He draws strength from hatred of the Scourge, yet rejects zealotry; freeing the spirits matters to him personally, including the hope of finding his mother among them.
A spectral combatant found in Stratholme that uses Wither Strike.
A spectral defender found in Stratholme. In combat, it uses Strike and Shield Block, giving it both an attack and a defensive response.
An undead Mossflayer zombie found in the Eastern Plaguelands. Its combat behavior includes an attack spell.
An undead Mossflayer found in the Eastern Plaguelands. It uses Wither Touch and can knock down nearby opponents.

Quartermaster Miranda Breechlock supplies equipment for the Argent Dawn, explaining that Duke Zverenhoff's valor tokens can improve standing or obtain special items. Miranda advises buyers to earn greater trust with the Dawn rather than pay steep insignia surcharges. Mantle purchases are presented as privileges that depend on maintaining the required standing.
Spectral marauders are ghostly undead raiders.
Spectral corpses are ghostly undead remains.
Kriss Goldenlight is a humanoid who offers a quest-giver interaction.
Adon is a humanoid who offers a quest-giver interaction.
Mirador is a beast in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Nathanos Blightcaller, Champion of the Banshee Queen, obeys the Dark Lady while treating her recruits with contempt. He demands purposeful killing of the Scourge and makes tending his hounds part of their harsh training. He seeks vengeance on Ramstein, recounting how he was overwhelmed defending Lordaeron and awakened under the Lich King’s control. He can recognize proven service with a place among his champions.
Blighthounds are hound creatures whose behavior includes casting Disease Cloud on respawn and using Rend at close range.

Borelgore is a huge maggot beast in the Eastern Plaguelands, feared by Nathanos Blightcaller as a devourer that has cost him entire regiments. Nathanos describes the creature as growing larger as it eats and sends hunters to destroy it.

Duskwing is an albino demon bat roaming north of Marris Stead in the Eastern Plaguelands. Nathanos Blightcaller considers the hunt a challenge and asks his agents to kill the bat and bring back a patch of its white fur.

Crusader Lord Valdelmar is a Scarlet Crusade commander at Tyr's Hand. A courier disguised as a Scarlet soldier is sent to deliver him the Grand Crusader's command; Valdelmar's response treats the returning messenger as a soldier and demands an explanation for the delay. He is a disciplined authority figure within the Scarlet command.

Infiltrator Hameya’s written plea asks for death before the lich can use the infection to spread it among more of Hameya’s people. The scroll recounts becoming infected after eating bad meat with companions on the way to Zul’Mashar, and offers buried treasure to anyone who will find and kill Hameya.

Zaeldarr the Outcast is a dead troll who leads other dead troll thieves from the Undercroft. Caretaker Alen says they steal bodies from the pit below Light’s Hope Chapel at night and carry them west to their hideout, making Zaeldarr a threat to the chapel and its keepers.
A Ziggurat Protector guards the ziggurat and fights intruders with a disorienting shout.
A Slaughterhouse Protector guards the slaughterhouse and fights intruders with a disorienting shout.
A Quel'Lithien Protector serves as a guard. In a fight, this humanoid uses a bow at range, strikes or kicks nearby opponents, and may flee for help when badly wounded.

A Crimson Courier carries a pouch meant for the High General and asks that it be delivered if the courier falls. The courier feels danger ahead and complains of a sore back, suggesting the journey is taxing. The courier is an elite humanoid.

Demetria, the Scarlet Oracle, is chief advisor to the Grand Crusader, and is credited with helping the Scarlet Crusade win several battles against the Scourge. Nathanos says a ruse exposed her and sends the player to hunt her and her entourage along the road between Tyr's Hand and Stratholme.
Scarlet Troopers are rank-and-file Scarlet combatants. A trooper casts Devotion Aura when it becomes hostile.

Augustus the Touched recalls running a Terrordale business buying and selling everything before the Scourge came. He wants his lost receipt book back so he can reopen shop, and promises extravagant prices. His energetic sales pitches show how eagerly he wants to resume trading.
Khaelyn Steelwing is a Gryphon Master who offers flight routes. When attacked, she calls for guards, and an enraged gryphon is summoned in response.
Georgia is a Bat Handler who offers flight routes. When attacked, she calls for guards, and an enraged felbat is summoned in response.
Jase Farlane sells trade supplies.
A Crimson bodyguard whose combat repertoire includes Shield Charge.

Eris Havenfire seeks to end a cursed existence by having a priest save the peasants Eris could not protect as they fled Stratholme. Eris invokes the Light, warns that the trial must be undertaken alone, and praises successful rescuers for their courage and tenacity. The reward is the Splinter of Nordrassil, followed by a charge to recover the Eye of Shadow.
A Scarlet inquisitor.
Elder Snowcrown welcomes those who still honor the olden races, offering a token and good wishes. Snowcrown describes the bright moon and new year as the time when the ancients awake.

Elder Windrun is an elder whose counsel turns to the stars and their meaning for the world. Windrun describes the stars as taking new paths and serving as beacons of hope and strength for ages to come, then wonders whether the wise and fortunate can read earthly truths in them.

Anthion Harmon regrets that he and others split Valthalak’s medallion without understanding its curse, and says Theldren beat him when he tried to reclaim a piece. He seeks help recovering the fragments and directs the effort to Falrin Treeshaper for a way to provoke Theldren. Anthion says restoring the medallion can stop the spell; at parting, he says he can finally rest and that his time in the world is short.

Korfax, Champion of the Light, represents the Brotherhood of the Light at Light's Hope. He seeks Dark Iron scraps to assemble Dreadnaught armor for the Brotherhood's champions, and his bargaining style is blunt and threatening. He describes the Brotherhood as Argent Dawn members unbound by conventional morals, contrasting it with the Scarlet Crusade's zealotry and poor leadership.

Father Inigo Montoy is a Brotherhood of the Light figure at Light's Hope. He warns that the Lich King's attempt to make his presence known in the world must be stopped. In his recorded exchanges, he thanks Mrs. Chambers, praises her food, and exclaims over a mango, giving his grave warning a strikingly genial everyday counterpoint.

A Scarlet Crusade commander sent as an emissary, Marjhan doubts that the Crusade and Argent Dawn can stop Kel'Thuzad without a miracle. Her involvement is unsanctioned by the Grand Crusader; she expects to die in battle, speaks contemptuously of the Horde, and still sees hope in Ashbringer.

A commander of the Brotherhood of the Light at Light's Hope, Eligor directs attention to Kel'Thuzad's renewed Scourge threat. He reports a sharp rise in attacks across the Plaguelands and as far away as Kalimdor, and questions how the undead reached there. Stern and probing, he speaks of duty and dedication, the Mograine legacy, and Scarlet leadership.

Archmage Angela Dosantos is a mage of the Brotherhood of the Light at Light's Hope Chapel. She describes adapting a Kirin Tor cantrip into arcane cloaking for entry to Naxxramas, with the price of her aid varying by Argent Dawn standing. Her remarks on Atiesh connect Kel'Thuzad's interest to Medivh.
Plagued Swine are beasts that use Boar Charge in combat.

Rohan the Assassin serves the Scarlet Crusade at Light's Hope Chapel. His quest text seeks Scourge bone fragments for Don Julio's Bonescythe armor, while his replies joke about dancing and a barber shop quartet. He calls his title misleading and says he is nice once known, giving his assassin's label a comic edge.

Huntsman Leopold is a Scarlet Crusade huntsman at Light's Hope Chapel who makes Cryptstalker armor for those venturing into Naxxramas. He needs crypt fiend parts to complete the work and offers a Crusade insignia for each bundle, presenting the exchange as an ongoing arrangement.

Mataus the Wrathcaster is a Scarlet Crusade enchanter who creates the Ice Guard and Shadow Guard, magical protections for equipment used against frost and shadow threats. He sets a firm price for his work and treats customers with open impatience, warning that Naxxramas is unkind to the uninitiated.

Rimblat Earthshatter identifies himself with the Earthen Ring. Speaking to a druid, he urges attention to the living earth and its desire to be cleansed, a fitting concern for an Earthen Ring member in the blighted Plaguelands.

Rayne serves the Cenarion Circle in the Plaguelands, where she studies local flora and makes Dreamwalker armor. She seeks savage fronds for that work and speaks with Rimblat about healing the blighted land; she says both the Argent Dawn and the Crusade fund her rewards.
This nerubian overseer is a dungeon enemy in the Eastern Plaguelands; in combat it casts Crypt Scarabs and uses Enveloping Web against nearby targets.

Dispatch Commander Metz serves the Argent Dawn at the Plaguelands front, issuing craftsman's writs only after adventurers prove themselves with a valor token. He directs completed orders to Packmaster Stonebruiser and handles a safe-passage writ. His brusque, taunting manner makes clear he expects people to earn his help.
A low-level beast called Pack Mule, present in both the Eastern Plaguelands and Hellfire Peninsula.

Guard Didier of the Brotherhood of the Light says adventurers helped his caravan reach safety after Scourge attacks. He is waiting for Field Marshal Chambers to arrive and sign a safe-passage writ, and warns that Chambers can be dangerously short-tempered.
An Argent Dawn infantryman serving in the order's ranks in the Eastern Plaguelands.
An injured Argent Dawn infantryman in the Eastern Plaguelands, a wounded rank-and-file soldier of the order.

Jessica Chambers is an innkeeper who welcomes strangers to Light's Hope Chapel and offers lodging and goods. She tells a Commander to enjoy a fish platter and asks someone she calls “Father” about a bowl of fruit.

The Keeper of the Rolls serves the Argent Dawn at Light’s Hope Chapel, welcoming help against the Scourge and hoping experienced volunteers will guide others by example. Moved by an old soldier’s undelivered words to a loved one, the Keeper hopes to locate the family with help from a Stormwind librarian who owes a favor. Unsure whether the intended recipient still lives, the Keeper sees the research as a chance to bring someone peace of mind.

Packmaster Stonebruiser of the Brotherhood of the Light handles supplies at Light's Hope Chapel, including work orders destined for the front. He complains that Scourge attacks are stopping Didier's mule caravans and calls for adventurers to protect them. His replies show a dry, irreverent streak: he mocks ill-suited gear, sings a joke about priests in a bottle, and cuts off questions with a glare and a curt refusal.

An Argent Dawn medic whose greeting conveys a heavy workload and impatience with interruptions. A visitor can ask for disease treatment; the medic's brief response makes clear they are pressed for time.

Argent Dawn commander at Light's Hope Chapel, Thomas Helleran directs the campaign against the Scourge. He presents the effort as a shared struggle, taking hope from incremental victories and encouraging fighters to return to the front after resting.

Brotherhood of the Light craftsman Wilhelm says Omarion vanished one night, leaving him to make goods for the front lines; he recalls that they were thick as thieves. His informal, wry remarks—including a joke about dying in clean pants—pair concern for the fighters with a lively sense of humor.
An Argent Dawn sentry found across the Eastern Plaguelands. When an enemy draws its attention, it responds with a charging attack.

Emissary Whitebeard speaks for the Alliance effort to retake abandoned towers in the Eastern Plaguelands and rebuild them as outposts. He warns that the land is dangerous and seeks help tightening pressure on the Forsaken. He also stresses that any captured towers will need to be held against future attacks while reinforcements are gathered.

Emissary Gormok argues for the Forsaken to block the Alliance from establishing bases in the Eastern Plaguelands. He calls the Alliance fools for approaching a Forsaken capital and vows to bleed their forces until they retreat. He presents the struggle over the towers as ongoing and asks for continued help driving the Alliance back.
The Crown Guard Tower capture target, part of the abandoned Eastern Plaguelands towers the Alliance seeks to seize and the Forsaken seek to deny them.
The Eastwall Tower capture target, one of the abandoned Eastern Plaguelands towers contested in Alliance plans to build outposts and the Forsaken effort to stop them.
The Northpass Tower capture target, one of the abandoned Eastern Plaguelands towers contested in Alliance plans to build outposts and the Forsaken effort to stop them.
Plaguewood Capture Quest Doodad is one of four tower objectives in the Eastern Plaguelands. The Horde quest frames the operation as stopping an Alliance effort to establish bases in abandoned towers.

Scourge Siege Engineers belong to a company staging siege equipment southeast of Quel'Thalas for an attack on the Ghostlands. The Blood Knights describe them as a threat to Quel'Thalas and its people.

Siouxsie the Banshee is a formidable, hostile presence associated with Ebon Hold, threatening Squire Edwards and dismissing visitors as worms. She recalls growing weary of training Death Knight initiates and their questions; a collector's-edition quest names her as its voucher recipient.

Squire Edwards is a deferential attendant to Siouxsie, whom he addresses as mistress. He stammers while offering to brush her steed, polish her armor, or bring corpse dust, and answers her with nervous obedience.
An undead Coldwraith found in the Eastern Plaguelands and Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.
A humanoid Disciple of Blood found in the Eastern Plaguelands and Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.
A humanoid Disciple of Frost found in the Eastern Plaguelands and Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.
A humanoid Disciple of the Unholy found in the Eastern Plaguelands and Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

Master Siegesmith Corvus is a master armorer who crafts weapons and armor, including powerful runeblades, at Ebon Hold. He grumbles that Death Knights abandon the gear he makes, waste precious saronite, and leave him with too much work and too little help. Even so, he still recognizes a fine blade when he sees one.

Amal'thazad trains Death Knights and offers help with talent changes and specialization. His greeting describes the group in wintry, deathly terms: “We are what the cold wind carries,” followed by images of despair and death. The line gives him a solemn, cryptic presence.
Lady Alistra is a Death Knight instructor whose teaching invokes the unholy power used to command death.
Lord Thorval teaches blood mastery as a way to control blood and weaken foes. His lessons describe draining energy from living and fallen enemies to sustain continued combat.
Alchemist Karloff is identified as a Corpse Dust vendor in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Corpulous is a named food and drink vendor in the Ebon Hold area.
Gangrenus is a named general goods vendor in the Ebon Hold area.
Fester is a Trade Goods vendor who lets visitors browse his wares.
A Risen Drudge is an undead creature found in the Eastern Plaguelands and the Scarlet Enclave.
A vigilant gargoyle is a watchful undead creature, defined by its generic guardian role rather than a distinct personal identity.
Highlord Darion Mograine is an undead highlord associated with the Eastern Plaguelands.
Grimwing is a gryphon flight master who asks where a traveler would like to fly.
Dread Commander Thalanor is a vendor.

Highlord Darion Mograine leads the Knights of the Ebon Blade through a fight for the order’s survival. He recalls plunging the Ashbringer into his own heart to free his father’s cursed soul, and teaches Death Knights to return to Acherus and help reclaim it from the Scourge. Seeking allies for the Ebon Blade, he asks an Alliance hero to represent the order to King Varian Wrynn.
Koltira Deathweaver is an undead figure in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Thassarian is an undead figure in the Eastern Plaguelands.
A Knight of the Ebon Blade is an order fighter who attacks with Icy Touch and Blood Strike, and also uses Plague Strike and Death Coil.
An elite undead Val'kyr Battle-maiden, this warrior uses Touch of the Val'kyr in combat.
Scourge Necromancers are spellcasting undead who attack with Shadow Bolt and Shadowflame. When badly hurt, this one may flee to seek help.
A terrifying undead abomination, this creature fights by striking nearby enemies with Cleave.

In the Heart of Acherus, Patchwerk is a stitched terror left by the Lich King, with a horde of abominations on the second floor. Death knights are directed to face him with allies; in combat, he uses Hateful Strike and can enter a frenzy.
A training dummy used as a practice target.
A training dummy used as a practice target.
A training dummy used as a practice target.
A training dummy used as a practice target; its name associates it with the Ebon Knights.
A training dummy named for the Highlord's nemesis. It shares the training-dummy role of the nearby practice targets, though its name distinguishes this specimen.

place_records.text: You are in Eastern Plaguelands, a blighted land in the Eastern Kingdoms that is held by neither the Alliance nor the Horde. Light's Hope Chapel and Death's Breach are its main settlements, and the Argent Dawn works from the chapel. Plaguebats and plaguehounds roam the fields, Scourge ghouls and Scarlet Crusade soldiers add to the danger, and troll raiders steal corpses from the chapel's cemetery.
You are in The Fungal Vale, a vale in the Eastern Plaguelands. Dark adepts, death singers and shadowmages haunt it, along with diseased flayers and Scourge champions.

You are in The Marris Stead, a Horde stead in the Eastern Plaguelands. Nathanos Blightcaller, Champion of the Banshee Queen, trains the Dark Lady's recruits here and keeps blighthounds that cast disease clouds. Plaguebats and plaguehound runts fly and run around it.

You are in The Undercroft, a place in the Eastern Plaguelands. Unliving mossflayers and mossflayer zombies haunt it, and Zaeldarr the Outcast is also here. Plaguebats and putrid gargoyles fly overhead.

You are in Darrowshire, a village in the Eastern Plaguelands that was destroyed in the war. A spirit healer is here among the ruins, and Pamela Redpath, a lonely undead girl, waits in her family's house. Plaguebats and Ghosts of the Past still haunt the streets.
You are in Crown Guard Tower, an old tower in the Eastern Plaguelands from the days of Lordaeron. Plaguebats, plaguehound runts and putrid gargoyles prowl around it.

You are in Corin's Crossing, a town in the Eastern Plaguelands that the Scourge still inhabit. Hate shriekers, vile tutors, dark casters and gibbering ghouls roam it, and dark summoners and noxious plaguebats join them.
You are in Scarlet Base Camp, a Scarlet Crusade camp in the Eastern Plaguelands. Scarlet warders, enchanters and clerics are hostile here, with plaguehound runts and plaguebats at its edges.

You are in Tyr's Hand, a place in the Eastern Plaguelands full of Scarlet Crusade fighters. Scarlet warders, enchanters, clerics, praetorians, curates and archmages are all hostile there, in large numbers.

You are in Light's Hope Chapel, where Argent Dawn officers work in the Eastern Plaguelands. Lord Maxwell Tyrosus and Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff are senior Argent Dawn figures, and Zverenhoff opposes Scarlet Crusade zealotry. Caretaker Alen complains that Zaeldarr's gang keeps stealing corpses from the cemetery pit. The chapel has an inn and repairs.
You are in Browman Mill, a mill in the Eastern Plaguelands. Death singers, dread weavers, Scourge champions and diseased flayers haunt the ground around it.

You are in The Noxious Glade, a glade in the Eastern Plaguelands. Lord Thorval teaches blood mastery here, a way of draining energy from living and fallen foes. Scourge champions, shadowmages, dark adepts and dread weavers haunt the glade.

You are in Eastwall Tower, an old tower in the Eastern Plaguelands from the days of Lordaeron that the Alliance and Horde have each tried to hold. Frenzied plaguehounds and monstrous plaguebats roam it, and Hed'mush the Rotting lurks here.

You are in Northdale, a war-torn hamlet in the northeastern Eastern Plaguelands, held by neither side. A spirit healer there offers a return to life for a price, though the traveler may not yet be ready. Death singers, eyeless watchers and blighted horrors haunt the hamlet.

You are in Zul'Mashar, a part of the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. Mossflayer shadowhunters, cannibals and scouts are the main dangers here, and Warlord Thresh'jin and Zul'Brin Warpbranch are among the notable ones.
You are in Northpass Tower, a stop in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side, where travelers can take to the air. Monstrous plaguebats and frenzied plaguehounds haunt the area around it.

You are in Quel'Lithien Lodge, an Alliance post in the Eastern Plaguelands where Quel'Lithien protectors and rangers keep watch. Ranger Lord Hawkspear is its notable ranger. Aurora Skycaller, a high elf troubled by her people's painful past, has agreed to help restore the Crystal of Zin-Malor, an artifact shattered through evil use.

You are in Plaguewood, a wood in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. Stitched horrors, cannibal ghouls, torn screamers and cursed mages roam it, along with plaguebats and plaguehounds. Eris Havenfire, a cursed spirit, mourns the peasants Eris could not protect as they fled Stratholme.

You are in Stratholme, a place in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. A spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. Anthion Harmon regrets splitting Valthalak's medallion without understanding its curse, and he is still trying to recover the fragments. Necromancers, stitched horrors and scourge warders are the dangers, and Baron Rivendare's undead hold Ysida Harmon prisoner.

You are in Thondroril River, a waterway in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. Tirion Fordring, banished for treason, is here trying to help his son Taelan recover what he has lost. Crypt horrors, crypt stalkers and nerubian overseers are the dangers.

You are in Lake Mereldar, a lake in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. Plague ravagers, blighted surges, plaguebats and putrid gargoyles are the dangers here, and carrion grubs feed on the dead.

You are in Pestilent Scar, a blighted land in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. Living decay, rotting sludge, noxious plaguebats and plaguehounds are the dangers, and a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price.

You are in The Infectis Scar, a scarred land in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. Ghostly spectral marauders and spectral corpses wander among living decay, noxious plaguebats and rotting sludge.

You are in Blackwood Lake, a lake in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. A spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. Noxious and monstrous plaguebats, blighted horrors and plague monstrosities are the dangers, and spectral defenders from Stratholme drift here.

You are in Terrordale, a settlement in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither side. A merchant trades here. Egan, an inventor, uses his blaster to free the tortured souls haunting Stratholme, and Augustus the Touched once ran a business here before the Scourge came. Crypt stalkers, scourge soldiers and cannibal ghouls are the dangers.

You are in Death's Breach, a settlement in the Eastern Plaguelands held by neither the Alliance nor the Horde. Highlord Darion Mograine leads the Knights of the Ebon Blade here, still fighting to take back Acherus from the Scourge. Terrifying abominations and Scourge necromancers roam nearby, and Val'kyr battle-maidens too. Its gryphon flight master and spirit healer serve travelers.
